milestones.name: WASM Integration & Sandbox
milestones.description: Establish key WASM bindings with Gestalt Engine and set up in-browser WebContainer sandboxing.

milestones.name: Offline Git & Sync
milestones.description: Enable in-browser Git operations with isomorphic-git and real-time Event Bus WS state synchronization.

milestones.name: Semantic Integration
milestones.description: Connect PWA cache structures offline and integrate Xavier semantic memories.

features.name: Gestalt WASM Integration
features.description: Integration with @swal/gestalt-wasm to execute parallel runs and read event stream schemas.
steps: Load compiled gestalt-wasm.wasm dynamically inside browser
E2E testing of execute_run_spec WASM calls

features.name: WebContainer Sandboxed Environment
features.description: Bootstrapping WebContainer in browser to execute workspace builds and agent code.
steps: Mount workspace files onto WebContainer filesystem
Spawn terminal processes inside the WebContainer

features.name: Isomorphic-Git Browser Client
features.description: Perform full git operations (clone, checkout, commit) directly inside browser using memory/IndexedDB filesystems.
steps: Implement clone, checkout, status, and commit workflows
Handle merge and conflict state marking

features.name: Event Bus & WebSocket Sync
features.description: Real-time synchronization and timeline streaming with Gestalt event bus (:8081) and WS server (:3001).
steps: Listen to timeline events and update React application state

features.name: Offline-First PWA State & Cache
features.description: Implement Service Worker, app manifests, and IndexedDB state caching for resilient offline-first work.
steps: Register Service Worker with custom asset caching
Design offline indicator and state synchronization queues
Configure manifest.json and universal PWA shell requirements

features.name: Xavier Semantic Memory Integration
features.description: Direct communication with Xavier for semantic memory search (PRE-run context) and run archival (POST-run result).
steps: Map GET/POST endpoints of Xavier client
Feed context into agent runs automatically
